_doc: The Pale Inheritance chapter 10, one against two. Hand-made (tools/maps/build_pale_inheritance_maps.py). Ysmay's mound in the west, the Barrow Below in the middle and two Ashen broods in the burning tunnels in the east: Skarn Ashborn's Burrow-Host in the north, Ithra Sootveil's brood in the south. The broods are allied computer players (team 1), at the easy difficulty (one against two). Laid out on a 34x26 grid and drawn 2.7x larger.
name: The Pale Crown
